text:
omar: Kicking off Skyline-9B onboarding. Quick tokenizer check shows a sentinel id 59000 that decodes to a private glyph (\\uF123). Looks like vendor left a placeholder. Anyone have a quick playbook for this? :shrug:

tess: seen similar. Two risks: kv-cache misalignment if ids are shifted; and rotary param mismatch if vendor used a different base. Share a tiny repro?

omar: repro: 
```
>>> tok.encode("Quick — test")
[334, 59000, 78, 2]
>>> tok.decode([334, 59000, 78, 2])
\"Quick \uF123 test\"
```
After 59000 later ids look offset vs our saved embedding ordering.

li: vendor metadata shows rotary_base: 100000 (yep, 1e5). Our runtime assumes 8192. That scale will absolutely warp rotary phases across positions. Also checkpoint vocab_size is 52000 so 59000 > vocab_size -> sentinel inserted post-export.

tess: immediate mitigation I'd do: 1) alias sentinel -> existing PAD id at tokenization time, 2) sparse-copy embedding row into PAD slot if sentinel row exists in ckpt, 3) normalize inv_freq by 8192/rotary_base and recompute sin/cos caches. Minimal invasive.

omar: sample alias snippet I used locally: 
```python
ALIAS = {59000: 0}  # map sentinel to PAD
def remap(ids):
    return [ALIAS.get(i, i) for i in ids]
# apply remap before embedding lookup
```
And sparse copy: 
```python
if 59000 < ckpt_vocab_size:
    emb[0] = emb[59000]
```

bench-bot: quick quant smoke (gptq-int4, default blocksize) on raw checkpoint: summarization ROUGE-L -3.4% vs fp16 baseline; MMLU -0.1%; C4 ppl +1.1. Notes: hit concentrated in long-form summarization.

li: for rotary rescale I tried: 
```python
rot_base = model.config.get('rotary_base', 8192)
if rot_base != 8192:
    scale = 8192.0 / float(rot_base)
    model.rotary.inv_freq *= scale
    if hasattr(model.rotary, 'precomputed'):
        model.rotary.recompute_caches()
```
Ran headwise attention check on a few tokens; max abs diff vs fp16 < 2e-4 after rescale.

tess: good. Plan: wire alias+sparse-copy+rotary-rescale into a conversion hook, run full eval battery overnight (summarization, convqa, mmlu, ppl). Also add id_alias.json alongside converted model to persist alias metadata.

omar: adding unit tests: 1) encode->remap->embed->decode roundtrip equality for a randomized sample; 2) assert max(token_id) < vocab_size after conversion.

ci-bot: CI note: queued long-run conversion and eval for skyline9b on staging pool at 01:45 UTC (est 6h). Branch: feat/skyline-sentinel-fix.

omar: thanks team — will post results in the morning. :coffee:
